listeningQuestions.audio: Monet's aim was to convey the light and movement in the scene.
opts: 莫奈的目标是表现场景中的光与动感。

listeningQuestions.audio: Chinese ink wash painting uses mainly water and black ink.
opts: 中国画只用鲜艳的油彩。

opts: 博物馆要卖掉所有画作。

listeningQuestions.audio: My advice is to copy a work you truly love first.
opts: 我的建议是先临摹一幅你真正喜爱的作品。

listeningQuestions.audio: Their aim was no longer to show reality, but to ask what art is.
opts: 他们只想精确复制照片。

reading.passage: After photography was invented, paintings were no longer needed simply to record how things looked. So painters had to find a new way of seeing. From this fresh thinking, Impressionism emerged, and artists began to paint light and feeling instead of every detail.
reading.passageCn: 摄影术发明之后,绘画不再仅仅用于记录事物的样貌。于是画家们必须找到新的观看方式。正是从这种新思维中,印象主义兴起了,艺术家们开始画光与感觉,而非每一个细节。

questions.q: Why were paintings no longer needed just to record how things looked?
What did painters have to find?
What did Impressionist artists begin to paint?
opts: Light and feeling rather than every detail.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences to introduce your favourite painting, artist, or art style. Say which period or style it belongs to and why you like it. Try to use the infinitive as the predicative (e.g. The aim of this style is to … / My wish is to …).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话介绍你最喜爱的一幅画、一位艺术家或一种艺术风格:它属于哪个时期或风格,你为什么喜欢它。试着用不定式作表语(如 The aim of this style is to … / My wish is to …)。

lines.text: Which painting do you like most in the museum?
lines.cn: 博物馆里你最喜欢哪幅画?

lines.text: Monet's Impression, Sunrise. The aim of that style is to catch light and feeling.
lines.cn: 莫奈的《印象·日出》。那种风格的目标是捕捉光与感觉。

lines.text: I see. So it doesn't try to copy every detail?
lines.cn: 原来如此。所以它并不想复制每个细节?

lines.text: Exactly. My own wish is to learn to paint the way I truly feel.
lines.cn: 正是。我自己的愿望是学会按我真正的感受去画。
